title: Quote approval with discount tiers
summary: Sales reps submit a quote; a discount authority table sets who approves, and each approver can approve, reject or counter before the CPQ is updated.
description:
Quote approval with discount tiers enforces your discount authority without chasing approvals over chat. The sales rep fills in the start form: quote id, customer, product, annual list price, discount, term, payment terms and a justification.

The workflow works out the net annual price and the deal value over the term, then evaluates the Discount authority decision table. Up to 10% is approved automatically; above that the sales manager approves, above 20% the VP sales as well, and above 30% (or on very large deals) the deal desk and the CFO join. Approvals run in sequence, each with a one-day due date, a reminder and escalation, and each approver can approve (adjusting the approved discount), reject or make a counter-offer.

The final decision is written to the quote in your CPQ system and the rep gets an email: approved with the discount and conditions, rejected with the reason, or the counter-offer to take back to the customer. Adapt the thresholds, the approver chain and the CPQ call to your sales policy.
start: Starts from a form: the sales rep submits the quote details (Run dialog in the app, or a button in your CPQ posting to the start API).

changelog.notes: Uses the new forms: a themed start form with a grid and header, and Approve / Reject / Counter-offer buttons with a grid and header on every approval tier.

setup: CPQ system: set the base URL and API token of your CPQ or CRM quoting API. Record quote approval posts to /quotes/{quote_id}/approval; adjust the path and body in Integrations.
Assignees: pick the default sales manager, VP sales, deal desk analyst and CFO (runs can pass sales_manager_id, vp_sales_id, deal_desk_id and cfo_id, for example from the rep's team).
Edit the Discount authority rules to your delegation of authority (discount bands, deal size, short terms).
Email: configure EMAIL_PROVIDER so reps receive the decision emails (the steps continue on error).

steps.title: Quote submitted
steps.body: The start form collects the quote id, customer, product, list price, discount, term, payment terms and justification.

steps.title: Price the deal
steps.body: The net annual price and the deal value over the term are calculated.

steps.title: Find the approval path
steps.body: The Discount authority decision table returns which approvers are needed: none, sales manager, VP sales, deal desk and CFO.

steps.title: Approve in sequence
steps.body: Each required approver approves (and can lower the approved discount), rejects or makes a counter-offer.

steps.title: Update the CPQ
steps.body: The decision and approved discount are recorded on the quote in the CPQ system.

steps.title: Tell the rep
steps.body: The rep is emailed the approval, the rejection reason or the counter-offer.

sample_input.justification: Competitive evaluation against an incumbent; two-year commitment with annual prepayment.
